pick.headline: NIH Streamlines Paperwork by Adding Supplement to Common Form
pick.take: A Common Form that needs a Supplement is a one-size-fits-all garment with its own alterations department. Scientists who could be doing research spend their Sundays telling the government what the government already has on file. Harmonization has never looked so redundant, or so thoroughly redundant.
